text:
violet: Customer hit duplicated webhook deliveries after a short 429 spike. Two identical side-effect POSTs ~180ms apart.
sam: Did they set Idempotency-Key?
violet: Yes for regular calls but their streaming helper path didn't attach it.
oscar: Also traces show client retried immediately on 429 while token refresh was in-flight. Refresh start at 14:12:10.500, retry at 14:12:10.650.
lisa: Stack those and you get two accepted requests. Missing header + unsafe immediate retry.
refresh-bot: Created ticket DX-3420: "streaming idempotency parity + refresh replay guard"
oscar: Short fixes: (1) sampleapp: attach idempotency for streaming helpers, (2) SDKs: add small refresh mutex/queue, (3) docs: call out server-side enforcement required.
sam: Minimal client-side snippet for sampleapp (JS):
```js
let refreshInFlight = false;
async function sendSafe(req) {
  if (refreshInFlight) await sleep(randInt(150, 300));
  return await sendWithJitteredBackoff(req);
}
async function refreshToken() { refreshInFlight = true; await doRefresh(); refreshInFlight = false }
```
lisa: We'll also expose client.safe_replay = true as opt-in to enable the guard for customers with expensive side-effects. Default stays false to avoid added latency for most apps.
oscar: Telemetry: emit metric retry.during_refresh with tags {sdk, route}. Helps detect patterns before customers call.
violet: I'll draft the customer mitigation e-mail: 1) enable server idempotency, 2) add client-side small debounce on refresh, 3) upgrade SDKs when patches land, 4) enable retry telemetry.
refresh-bot: PRs opened: node-sdk#518, go-sdk#276, python-samples#88. CI queued.
sam: Thanks team. Let's prioritize Node/Go helpers this sprint and Python samples/docs next.
refresh-bot: Incident record dup-replay-2026-06-11 created.
